acceptance_rule: Source ZIP hash and schema, exact CIK mapping, PIT clock, entry/exit fields, and fingerprint coverage must validate. Every window must retain at least 20 settled top1 decisions, 10 target tickers, 10 peer tickers, and target/peer top1 shares at most 30 percent. Accepted default-off alpha requires positive standalone net PnL and positive cash and QQQ replacement value in every window; core-plus-sleeve aggregate EV delta must exceed 0.5286 and PnL delta exceed 10432.91 with at least two improved and no materially regressed windows, worst drawdown no more than 0.5 percentage point worse, and top-five positive-PnL share at most 60 percent. DSR probability at least 0.95 over a complete declared selection panel is required only for live eligibility.
